title: AeroStore 30-Day Return & Refund Policy
content:
AeroStore 30-Day Return & Refund Policy

AeroStore offers a 30-day risk-free return guarantee on all physical products purchased from our storefront. To be eligible for a full refund, items must be in their original packaging, with all accessories, cables, and documentation included. Customers can initiate an RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) via the portal or customer service. Once received at our fulfillment hub, refunds are credited to the original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Return shipping is completely free for damaged or defective units.

title: ADR-001: Adoption of Microservices Architecture for Online Shopping
content:
ADR-001: Adoption of Microservices Architecture for Online Shopping

Context: The AeroStore e-commerce platform must scale to handle 10,000 concurrent shopping sessions with peak bursts during flash sales. Decision: Adopt a microservices architecture separating Product Catalog, Cart, Order Orchestration, and Payment Gateway into discrete domains. Consequences: Facilitates independent autoscaling, fault isolation (a spike in cart updates does not degrade catalog browsing), and contract-first REST boundaries with OpenAPI 3.0. Mitigates monolithic single-point-of-failure risks at the cost of distributed transaction orchestration.

title: ADR-002: Strict Prohibition of AI/LLMs in Payment Settlement & Financial Invariants
content:
ADR-002: Strict Prohibition of AI/LLMs in Payment Settlement & Financial Invariants

Context: Proposals were evaluated regarding using GenAI LLMs to negotiate dynamic discounts and automate payment settlement logic. Decision: AI/LLMs are strictly forbidden from participating in payment settlement, price calculation, or financial transaction authorization. Rationale: LLMs are non-deterministic and susceptible to prompt injection, hallucinated discount states, and parameter tampering. Payment settlement must execute exclusively through deterministic ACID code with RFC 7807 structured problem details, strict idempotency tokens, and a hard 1500ms SLA timeout with automated saga rollback.

title: Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) & Cart Versioning Invariants
content:
Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) & Cart Versioning Invariants

AeroStore utilizes Optimistic Concurrency Control (OCC) to guarantee cart consistency across multiple browser tabs and mobile sessions. Every cart state contains an integer `concurrency_version` token. Any mutation (add item, update quantity, remove item) must submit the `expected_version`. If a concurrent modification has updated the version in the interim, the server rejects the request with an RFC 7807 HTTP 409 Conflict status. This prevents lost update race conditions without requiring coarse-grained database locks.

title: Promotional Coupons, Eligibility Rules & Stacking Policy
content:
Promotional Coupons, Eligibility Rules & Stacking Policy

AeroStore provides verified promotional coupon codes with automated validation rules: 1. `SAVE20`: Grants 20% discount on orders where cart subtotal is $50 or more. 2. `FLASH50`: Grants 50% discount on flash sales for orders exceeding $200. 3. Stacking Policy: Only one promotional coupon code can be applied per checkout session. 4. Edge Case Codes: Code `EXPIRED30` is permanently expired (testing HTTP 400 rejection), and `MINSPEND100` requires a minimum spend of $100.00. Maximum item quantity per cart line item is strictly capped at 99 units.
